description: This file contains adapter code for converting between ReplicationController (RC) and ReplicaSet (RS) objects in Kubernetes, including conversion functions, informer and lister wrappers, and client interface adaptations.

classes.name: informerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter that implements ReplicaSetInformer by wrapping a ReplicationControllerInformer and converting objects.

classes.name: conversionInformer
classes.description: Wrapper around SharedIndexInformer to convert RC objects to RS objects.

classes.name: conversionLister
classes.description: Lister that converts RC objects to RS objects.

classes.name: conversionNamespaceLister
classes.description: Namespace-specific lister converting RC to RS.

classes.name: conversionEventHandler
classes.description: Event handler that converts RC events to RS events.

classes.name: clientsetAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for clientset.Interface to provide conversion-aware methods.

classes.name: conversionAppsV1Client
classes.description: Client wrapper for apps/v1 API with conversion logic.

classes.name: conversionClient
classes.description: Client wrapper for replication controllers with conversion functions.

classes.name: podControlAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PodControlInterface to handle RS to RC conversion.

methods.name: Informer
methods.description: Returns the SharedIndexInformer, with object conversion.

methods.name: Lister
methods.description: Returns a lister that converts RC objects to RS objects.

methods.name: AddEventHandler
methods.description: Adds an event handler with object conversion.

methods.name: AddEventHandlerWithResyncPeriod
methods.description: Adds an event handler with resync period and object conversion.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists RC objects converted to RS objects.

methods.name: ReplicaSets
methods.description: Returns namespace-specific lister for RS objects.

methods.name: GetPodReplicaSets
methods.description: Gets RS objects associated with a Pod.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Gets an RS object by name, converting from RC.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an RS object via RC conversion.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an RS object via RC conversion.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates RS status via RC conversion.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Patch method not implemented for conversionClient.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Apply method not implemented for conversionClient.

methods.name: GetScale
methods.description: GetScale method not implemented for conversionClient.

methods.name: UpdateScale
methods.description: UpdateScale method not implemented for conversionClient.

methods.name: ApplyScale
methods.description: ApplyScale method not implemented for conversionClient.

methods.name: convertSlice
methods.description: Converts a slice of RC objects to RS objects.

methods.name: convertList
methods.description: Converts a list of RC objects to RS list.

methods.name: convertCall
methods.description: Helper to convert RC to RS, call a function, then convert back.

methods.name: convertRCtoRS
methods.description: Converts a single RC object to RS.

methods.name: convertRStoRC
methods.description: Converts an RS object to RC.

methods.name: CreatePods
methods.description: Creates Pods from RS, converting RS to RC.

methods.name: DeletePod
methods.description: Deletes a Pod, converting RS to RC.
